answer: A Bug report with a fix signed off by a domain expert backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the bug report with a fix is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lone jade proves nothing about craft; only the reviewed record counts. The jetty marks the start and the ocean the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
